clauses.clause: The bay stays open; firefighter repeats "Get in!"; infected stay live until entry; shutter closes with the corgi inside.
clauses.note: All16 fresh low/high production-follow frames personally inspected. Physical keyboard entry199commands/tier after8s idle, no teleport or injected movement. Three actual Get-in calls at6408/6648/6888ticks; gate remains open before entry,22/52 minimum living infected move up to32.10/38.59m. Entry and first closed gate both7119; corgi signed inside depth1.05m on closure, visible again in settled frame. Seven broken-data controls pass. Damage protection is solely for mechanics/presentation. Gate state establishes closure; inside-follow camera makes building transparent, so no unoccluded exterior shutter-animation claim. Separate presentation observation: large dark triangular building surfaces at entry in both qualities, exact physical-inside/entry-end frames retained for PO.
